title: Diagnostic-reasoning rules (diagnostic-reasoning-rules)
description: Thresholds of the diagnostic-reasoning core and the rules the platform adapters share: diagnosis families, working-diagnosis label matching, the closure-alert contradiction threshold and the coexisting states. Read by lib/triage-engine/src/diagnostic-reasoning/reasoning-rules.ts (web) and DiagnosticReasoningRules.swift (iOS, DiagnosticReasoningRules.RuleFile; the thresholds are compiled into DiagnosticReasoningCore.swift and pinned to this file by diagnostic-reasoning-parity.test.ts).

supportLr.description: A present finding with LR >= this supports the hypothesis.

againstLr.description: A present (or documented-absent) finding with LR <= this argues against it.

favourLr.description: A finding favours another hypothesis when its LR there is >= this.

lowEvidenceLr.description: No supporting finding with LR >= this: 'low evidence'.

strongContradictionLr.description: Core premature-closure alert: a finding against the working diagnosis with LR <= this.

strongFavourLr.description: The finding that drives the leader has an LR ratio >= this (leader / working).

lessLikelyRatio.description: The leader is at least this many times more probable than the working diagnosis...

news2RiseMin.description: NEWS2 rise (latest minus the lowest earlier reading) that raises an alert...

news2AlertMin.description: ...when the latest NEWS2 is at least this (RCP NEWS2: 5 = urgent response).

unexplainedTimeOut.description: Diagnostic time-out: this many recorded findings unexplained by the leading diagnoses.

minGain.description: Expected information gain (nats) below which a probe is not offered.

maxClosureAlerts.description: At most this many premature-closure alerts.

contradictionMaxLr.description: A single contradicting finding raises 'Doesn't fit the working diagnosis' only at LR <= this (the core flags <= strongContradictionLr).

labelMatchMin.description: Label score (words found - words missing) needed when an ICD-10 match exists.

labelMatchMinAlone.description: Label score needed when the ICD-10 code matches no node.

labelMatchMargin.description: The label match must beat the ICD-10 match's own label score by this.

opposites.description: Neutral words that contradict each other (acute / chronic).

complicationModifiers.description: Label words that mark a complication or a grade of a condition.

genericTailWords.description: Trailing label words that are not the head noun.

synonyms.description: Spelling / synonym normalisation of label words.

injuryChapter.description: ICD-10 chapter letter of injuries: two injuries of one block (S2x, S3x) are one family.

paneIds.description: PANE disease ids of states that accompany other diagnoses (web).

nameTerms.description: The same states by name, for engines without PANE ids (iOS: a candidate name containing one).
